title: Thomson 32HE5800 (TCL-built: ro.product.model UnionTV, persist.tcl.client_type THOM-EU-RT2841-S1),
notes:
Thomson 32HE5800 (TCL-built: ro.product.model UnionTV, persist.tcl.client_type THOM-EU-RT2841-S1),
Realtek RTD284x (RT2841), Android TV 9 (API 28), build PPR2.180905.006.A1 (2020-11-15),
1.4 GB RAM with ro.config.low_ram=true, 1280x720 panel. Spain (Orange TV preloaded).

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/thomson-32he5800/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/thomson-32he5800/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (restore.sh / build-and-install.sh defaults work).
Other HOME claimants: com.orange.es.androidtv (Orange TV, priority 0) and two FallbackHome
activities (com.tcl.keycustomfunctionservice, com.android.tv.settings). setupwraith is installed
but does not claim HOME on this Android TV 9 firmware.
Live TV app: com.tcl.tv, inputs via com.tcl.tvinput / com.tcl.tvpassthrough. Keyboard: TCL T_IME.
launcher/ config: live_tv_package com.tcl.tv (its TVActivity has a leanback entry, no live_tv_action
needed); hide com.tcl.tv from the tiles. HDMI 1/2, AV and Live TV all show up in the Inputs menu.

Applied and verified on a real unit on 2026-10-19: Wi-Fi stayed up, launcher/ installed with the
default build-and-install.sh, Home and the Inputs menu worked after the full list.

Second unit, France (OQEE by Free preloaded), applied 2026-10-23: same client_type and build
PPR2.180905.006.A1 (builder date 2021-01-25), TCL software V8-R41KT01-LF1V374.009210, 32" (soc_32).
Retail label not read (covered by a wall mount). Disabled in batches with a screenshot after each,
launcher/ installed with the default build-and-install.ps1, rebooted, then checked with the real IR
remote: Home, Source, Netflix, Prime Video and Settings buttons all work, as do HDMI 1/2, AV, Live TV.
- com.tcl.waterfall.overseas (below) is installed on this unit: a TCL content app bundling Google
Mobile Ads and Firebase. Disabled without side effects.
- The "GalaView" tile is not its own app but com.tcl.partnercustomizer/.tkey.TKeyGalaActivity, so it
stays enabled (key handling); hide it from the launcher with hidden_apps com.tcl.partnercustomizer.
- com.google.android.katniss is re-enabled by the firmware at every boot here; pumpkin stays off.
- com.google.android.music is not installed on this unit.

DO NOT DISABLE here (load-bearing or unclear, run as android.uid.system):
com.tcl.tv com.tcl.tvinput com.tcl.tvpassthrough com.tcl.sourcemananger   # Live TV, HDMI, tuner, Source menu
com.tcl.autopair com.tcl.tcl_bt_rcu_service com.tcl.keycustomfunctionservice  # remote, BT pairing
com.tcl.framework.custom com.tcl.keyhelp com.tcl.partnercustomizer  # key handling (TKey activity)
com.tcl.inputmethod.international com.tcl.settings com.tcl.initsetup com.tcl.factory.view
com.tcl.common.terminalmanagerplus com.tcl.xian.StartandroidService com.tcl.appstatecontroller
com.tcl.copydatatotv com.android.ListenNetStateService       # unclear roles; boot/package/network hooks
com.realtek.netflix.setting                                  # Netflix ESN/config
Telemetry and analytics
